1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.VertexFanCutEdgeCircles

7 /-! The actual triangles incident to an original tree vertex cover its
8 entire cone angle. This discharges the local geometric budget obligation. -/
9 
10 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.VertexFaceFan
11 
12 open Set EuclideanGeometry
13 
14 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {pole : P.Vertex} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
15   (fan : P.VertexFaceFan pole n) (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
16     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
17       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
18 
19 include size small_faces in
20 /-- At an original vertex the actual incident triangle corners cover the full cone angle. -/
21 theorem incident_triangle_angles_cover_cone (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
22     [Fintype T.vertices] [DecidableRel T.graph.Adj]
23     (triangles : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeTriangles T d.adj)
24     (u : T.vertices) (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (pole : Space)) :
25     fan.totalAngle ≤ T.incidentAngleSum (fun d => (triangles d).model) u := by
26   classical
27   letI : Fact (0 < fan.totalAngle) := ⟨fan.totalAngle_pos⟩
28   let D (v : T.graph.neighborSet u) := triangles (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v)
29   choose radius positive arcs using fun v : T.graph.neighborSet u =>
30     fan.cut_edge_corner_circle_arcs small_faces (D v) at_vertex
31   obtain ⟨ε, ep, cone_link⟩ := fan.fanCircleMap_small_link_surjective size small_faces
32   obtain ⟨δ, dp, triangle_link⟩ := small_incident_triangles_cover_small_links size small_faces a T triangles u
33   let V : Set ℝ := Iio ε ∩ Iio δ ∩ ⋂ v : T.graph.neighborSet u, Iio (radius v)
34   have openV : IsOpen V := (isOpen_Iio.inter isOpen_Iio).inter
35     (isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun _ => isOpen_Iio))
36   have zeroV : (0 : ℝ) ∈ V := ⟨⟨ep, dp⟩, mem_iInter.mpr positive⟩
37   obtain ⟨R, Rp, ballV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp openV 0 zeroV
38   let ρ := R / 2
39   have ρp : 0 < ρ := by dsimp [ρ]; positivity
40   have small : ρ ∈ V := ballV (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos ρp]; dsimp [ρ]; linarith)
41   choose f g boundedf boundedg coversf coversg using fun v : T.graph.neighborSet u =>
42     arcs v ρ ⟨ρp, mem_iInter.mp small.2 v⟩
43   let width : (T.graph.neighborSet u ⊕ T.graph.neighborSet u) → ℝ := Sum.elim
44     (fun v => angle (D v).model.first (D v).model.left (D v).model.right)
45     (fun v => angle (D v).model.second (D v).model.left (D v).model.right)
46   let maps : (T.graph.neighborSet u ⊕ T.graph.neighborSet u) → ℝ → AddCircle (fan.totalAngle) :=
47     Sum.elim f g
48   have covered : ∀ z : AddCircle (fan.totalAngle), ∃ i, z ∈ maps i '' Icc (0 : ℝ) (width i) := by
49     intro z
50     obtain ⟨x, _, sphere, at_z⟩ := cone_link ρ ⟨ρp, small.1.1⟩ z
51     obtain ⟨v, edge, first | second⟩ := triangle_link ρ ⟨ρp, small.1.2⟩ x
52       (by rw [at_vertex]; exact sphere)
53     · obtain ⟨q, hq, folded⟩ := first
54       refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨v, edge⟩, ?_⟩
55       have member := coversf ⟨v, edge⟩ q hq
56       have folded_space : ((D ⟨v, edge⟩).first_triangle.homeomorph.symm q).val.val = (x : Space) :=
57         congrArg Subtype.val folded
58       rw [folded_space, at_z] at member
59       exact member
60     · obtain ⟨q, hq, folded⟩ := second
61       refine ⟨Sum.inr ⟨v, edge⟩, ?_⟩
62       have member := coversg ⟨v, edge⟩ q hq
63       have folded_space : ((D ⟨v, edge⟩).second_triangle.homeomorph.symm q).val.val = (x : Space) :=
64         congrArg Subtype.val folded
65       rw [folded_space, at_z] at member
66       exact member
67   have bound := circle_cover_length (fan.totalAngle) maps (fun _ => 0) width
68     (by intro i; cases i <;> exact angle_nonneg _ _ _)
69     (by intro i; cases i with | inl v => exact boundedf v | inr v => exact boundedg v)
70     covered
71   simpa only [sub_zero, Fintype.sum_sum_type, width, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
72     ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, CutLocusTree.incidentAngleSum, D] using bound
73 
74 include size small_faces in
75 /-- The inequality is independent of all choices of planar metric model. -/
76 theorem incident_model_angles_cover_cone (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
77     [Fintype T.vertices] [DecidableRel T.graph.Adj]
78     (models : (d : T.graph.Dart) → CutEdgeMetricModel T d.adj)
79     (u : T.vertices) (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (pole : Space)) :
80     fan.totalAngle ≤ T.incidentAngleSum models u := by
81   classical
82   let triangles (d : T.graph.Dart) := Classical.choice (small_exists_cut_edge_triangles size small_faces a T d.adj)
83   have bound := fan.incident_triangle_angles_cover_cone size small_faces a T triangles u at_vertex
84   have same : T.incidentAngleSum (fun d => (triangles d).model) u = T.incidentAngleSum models u := by
85     apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
86     intro v _
87     have angles := ((triangles (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v)).model).same_edge_corner_angles
88       (models (T.graph.dartOfNeighborSet u v))
89     exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) angles.1 angles.2
90   exact bound.trans_eq same
91 
92 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.VertexFaceFan
